description: cypher_space_01 is a crew of builders from Beni Mellal who turn curiosity into code and wild ideas into launches. This Space Apps, we’re taking on astronaut health: software that keeps crews safe on Mars when Mission Control is 20 minutes away, and brings the same care to remote places on Earth. Our mission is clear and our crew is ready. Ground control, stand by: Beni Mellal is going to space.
